title: Symbol from Name
short: Given the element's name, give its symbol.
trouble: Confusing the symbol's language (Latin names) with the English name.

blocks.html: The periodic table is a map you can read. This drill works on given the element's name, give its symbol.
Tip: Symbols are one or two letters; the first is capital. Many come from Latin: sodium is Na, potassium K, iron Fe.
Questions are generated from the published element data — the same numbers the Periodic table dataset shows.
